official.description: The Apoyo Complementario SECIHTI-OEA is a complementary support awarded jointly by Mexico's Secihti and the OAS to students who already hold a Secihti National Scholarship for a full-time postgraduate programme in Mexico. The OAS contribution is a single payment of USD 1,200 for settling-in expenses, and the call does not establish tuition, travel or full living-cost coverage.

applicant_utility.summary: This is not a scholarship you can apply for: the only entry route was already holding a current Secihti National Scholarship from one of six named 2025-2026 calls and being on the list Secihti sent the OAS on 28 August 2026. The award itself is a single USD 1,200 payment for settling-in expenses in Mexico, paid in pesos at the day's official exchange rate, on top of your existing Secihti monthly support and ISSSTE medical cover. As of 10 October 2026 the selection and formalisation steps have already run, so what remains is the documentation and disbursement phase before the 30 November 2026 process close.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Mexican OAS Member State nationals already holding a Secihti National Scholarship in a listed STEM, health, biotechnology or agricultural field in Mexico.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you were a current Secihti national scholarship holder from one of the six listed calls before 28 August 2026
Watch for the OAS's email requesting information and documentation for formalisation, and answer within the stated time frame
Keep a Mexican bank account ready to receive the deposit, since payment is made in pesos at the official exchange rate
Check you are not excluded by the restrictions (previous OAS complementary support, or a non-compliance record under programme S190)
common_rejection_risks: Not being on the Secihti list sent to the OAS on 28 August 2026 - no late additions are possible
Ignoring the OAS's documentation request: after one emailed prevención with at least five business days to fix it, the support can be cancelled and reassigned
A non-compliance record or outstanding debt under the Secihti S190 programme
Having previously received an OAS complementary support
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, flights and general living costs: the OAS portion covers settling-in expenses only, while the Secihti scholarship remains your main support and Secihti does not handle immigration procedures for you or your dependents.
document_audit: The documentation the OAS requests is for formalisation and disbursement, so respond in the exact format and channel the OAS emails specify

applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Already-selected holders simply formalise the instrument with the OAS, send the requested documentation, and receive the USD 1,200 deposit once formalised, all before the 30 November 2026 close.

official.description: The COMEXUS Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program funds US candidates to complete a master's or PhD degree at a qualified Mexican academic institution. The Commission will fund up to two academic years for a master's and up to three for a PhD, with financial support comprising monthly maintenance, a round-trip air ticket, a Fulbright medical benefit plan, visa assistance and up to 50,000 pesos per academic year toward tuition.
official.english_requirement: Spanish is required at an advanced level. Both the Language Self-Evaluation and the Foreign Language Evaluation completed by a qualified evaluator must be submitted, and failure to submit these forms makes the application ineligible; shortlisted candidates are interviewed in Spanish.

applicant_utility.summary: The COMEXUS Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program funds US citizens through a master's or PhD at a Mexican institution with monthly maintenance, a round-trip ticket, Fulbright medical cover, visa help and up to 50,000 pesos a year toward tuition. The 2026-27 window closed on 6 October 2026 at 5:00 PM EST, so the practical move now is preparing for the next cycle, which follows the same annual rhythm. Advanced Spanish is non-negotiable: the two language forms must be submitted or the application is ruled ineligible, and shortlisting means a Spanish-language interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: US citizens with fluent advanced Spanish and at least a B.S./B.A. pursuing a master's or PhD in Mexico outside medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry.
application_readiness_checklist: Build advanced Spanish through coursework or immersion well before the next cycle opens around March
Identify a qualified evaluator early who can complete the Foreign Language Evaluation, since missing language forms make the application ineligible
Line up three referees and pre-register them, as recommendations are uploaded directly by referees through the online system
Gather transcripts from every degree-granting institution and any institution where you took 12 or more credits
Draft the Statement of Grant Purpose around country and institution choice, academic background, language skills and community engagement, and keep it distinct from the short-answer sections
common_rejection_risks: Missing either the Language Self-Evaluation or the Foreign Language Evaluation, which makes the application ineligible outright
Being a permanent or temporary resident of Mexico, or studying, living or working in Mexico during the application
Applying in medicine, veterinary medicine or dentistry
Failing to secure admission to a qualified programme, since grantees do not receive the award until admitted
Requesting a deferral, which is not allowed
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above the 50,000-peso annual ceiling and personal expenses beyond the unpublished monthly maintenance amount.
document_audit: The Program Information section needs a field of study, clear project title and abstract - reviewers use it to grasp the what, where and why quickly
The affiliation letter should state that the programme is available and admission is feasible from a preliminary review of your background
Recommenders must be registered in the system and watch for the system-generated email; institutional email addresses are preferred
Research with human or animal subjects needs home-institution IRB approval, and host-institution clearance after selection
alerts: Most Mexican universities' own admission calls open after the Fulbright close, so a letter of acceptance is not required at application time - but the award is not released until you are admitted
The mandatory COMEXUS welcome orientation in Mexico City applies to August and September starters
Continuation funding after the first year depends on academic performance and fund availability
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: During the open call, complete the COMEXUS online application with all uploads and language forms, await a possible Spanish-language interview, then secure university admission in Mexico before the grant starts.
